units.source_text: 这时候，名人的背影总好像失去了平衡。

en.t: At such moments, the Master's figure from behind always seemed to have lost its balance.

units.source_text: 就是说，他还没有从专心于围棋的境界中苏醒过来。

en.t: That is to say, he had not yet awakened from the state of being wholly absorbed in Go.

units.source_text: 挺直的上半身仍然保持对局时的姿势，脚跟显得站不稳的样子。

en.t: His upright upper body still kept the posture he had held during the match, while his heels seemed unsteady, as if he could not quite stand firm.

units.source_text: 恍如一个具有崇高精神的影子浮在虚空之中。

en.t: It was as though a shadow possessed of a lofty spirit were floating in empty space.

units.source_text: 名人茫然若失，上半身依然一动不动，姿态上保持了面对棋盘时的余韵。

en.t: The Master stood there as if bereft, his upper body still completely motionless, his posture retaining the lingering afterimage of facing the Go board.
